TEXT: [#800080]The[] [#800080]Roaring[] [#800080]Knight[] has access to #yShadow cards, which #yExhaust themselves at the start of each combat. You can get these cards into your hand with cards like #bWormhole.
[#800080]The[] [#800080]Roaring[] [#800080]Knight[] also has access to #yTitan cards. Some cards may require you to play a certain number of #yTitan cards to activate specific effects.
You will activate #yThe #yRoaring upon playing your #b7th #yTitan card each combat! This gets you a massive amount of #yStrength and #yDexterity each turn, as well as making #yTitan cards cost #b0.
